sections.title: Growth and identification
sections.text: White mustard is an annual, rough-haired brassica, generally about 50–100 cm tall. Its lower leaves are lobed; the yellow four-petalled flowers develop into bristly pods with a flattened, seedless beak.

sections.title: Seeds and use
sections.text: The pale yellow seeds, about 2–3 mm across, are cultivated and ground or mixed into mustard condiment. Mustard is a recognized food allergen; the sources consulted do not support treating the plant as safe for everyone.
